name: Abihail
overview: The name Abihail appears in Scripture associated with multiple individuals, highlighting their distinct roles within God's providential plan. Abihail is noted as the father of Esther, whose favor before the king was pivotal for the preservation of God's people (Esther 2:15). Additionally, Abihail is identified as the wife of Abishur and as the second wife of Rehoboam, bearing him children who contributed to the Davidic lineage (1 Chronicles 2:29; 2 Chronicles 11:18-19). Furthermore, Abihail is recorded as the father of Zuriel, a leader of the Merarite clan responsible for tabernacle duties (Numbers 3:35). These references collectively underscore the varied yet significant roles connected to the name Abihail in biblical history.
